text: Announcement26 July 2026·All news·Original post on aa-classic.com ArcheAge Classic: Discovery (1.3.6) Trailer The trailer for ArcheAge Classic's next major patch is out now! Watch it on our website, or on our YouTube channel. A comet has been spotted inching closer and closer towards Auroria! Iseren's analysis have projected it to land in the territory of Exeloch. Anthalon, the Leader of the Crimson Army, has taken special interest as the comet nears landing. What disaster could fall upon Erenor should the ancient necromancer harness this power? The consequences or potential challenges, should Anthalon acquire the Comet fragment, are potentially limitless. Coming in Late August, the next chapter of ArcheAge Classic, Discovery, will see the mysterious energy of the comet looming over the sky bring new items, challenges, and even a new profession for players to explore! https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cbcjfImbLPY

Announcement26 July 2026·All news·Original post on aa-classic.com
ArcheAge Classic: Discovery (1.3.6) Trailer
The trailer for ArcheAge Classic's next major patch is out now! Watch it on our website, or on our YouTube channel.

A comet has been spotted inching closer and closer towards Auroria! Iseren's analysis have projected it to land in the territory of Exeloch.

Anthalon, the Leader of the Crimson Army, has taken special interest as the comet nears landing. What disaster could fall upon Erenor should the ancient necromancer harness this power? The consequences or potential challenges, should Anthalon acquire the Comet fragment, are potentially limitless.

Coming in Late August, the next chapter of ArcheAge Classic, Discovery, will see the mysterious energy of the comet looming over the sky bring new items, challenges, and even a new profession for players to explore!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cbcjfImbLPY
